challenges.name: cart-recalc-yielding
challenges.title: Reprice the cart without blocking taps
challenges.description: Applying a promo code to a large group order reprices every line in one loop: about 600 ms on a budget phone, and every tap in the meantime waits (INP 640 ms on /cart). Complete `recalcCart(items, promo, env)` so it works in slices and yields to the main thread between them. The editor holds `cart/recalc.js` with its key blocks missing, each marked by a `// [ ]` line; some pieces are wrong on purpose. Rules: price every line with `env.price(item)` (it takes main-thread time) and add a discount of `round(line * percent / 100)` for lines in the promo's category; once the current slice has used `env.budgetMs`, await `env.yield()` and start a new slice; do not yield while the work still fits in one slice; when `env.signal` is aborted (a newer promo code was applied), stop and return `null` without rendering; otherwise render the totals `{ subtotal, discount, total }` once and return them. Run measures the longest task, the delay of every tap and the number of yields on a simulated main thread.
hints: Picture the main thread as one queue: a tap can only run between two tasks. Where does one task end in your loop, and how long can it get?
Look at `env.now()` before and after the work, `await env.yield()` (without `await` nothing waits for it), a slice start that moves forward after each yield, and `env.signal.aborted` after a yield.

Sending 5,000 analytics events without freezing the page looks like: `let start = performance.now(); for (const e of events) { queue(e); if (performance.now() - start >= 40) { await scheduler.yield(); start = performance.now(); } if (signal.aborted) return; } flush();`

tests.name: 400 lines: correct totals, rendered once, no task over 50 ms and at most 20 yields
Taps during the recalculation wait at most 50 ms each
A newer promo code during the work: stop, return null and render nothing
A small cart fits in one slice: no yield at all
Discount is rounded per line, only for the promo's category
